crossRefs.note: All of your men of war shall march around the city, going around the city once. You shall do this six days.
So he caused Yahweh’s ark to go around the city, circling it once. Then they came into the camp, and stayed in the camp.
On the seventh day, they rose early at the dawning of the day, and marched around the city in the same way seven times.…

translations.web: The second day they marched around the city once, and returned into the camp. They did this six days.
translations.bsb: So on the second day they marched around the city once and returned to the camp. They did this for six days.
translations.kjv: And the second day they compassed the city once, and returned into the camp: so they did six days.
translations.asv: And the second day they compassed the city once, and returned into the camp: so they did six days.
